mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below 100 (a 5% decline from base) in a slowdown regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 2.5% signals potential central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or HOUST growth is not associated with positive 60-day returns (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payroll growth exceeding 0.5% and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.1pp indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE declines by more than 0.1pp (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, GDP growth exceeding 2.0% signals sustained economic momentum, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% in late-cycle expansions (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
